answer_1.quote: Advancements in natural language processing, particularly through the development of LLMs like GPT-4, PaLM, and LLaMA have introduced the potential to address these gaps on a large scale. LLMs excel in generating humanlike text and adapting content to various contextual needs.

answer_2.quote: We used BERTopic for topic modeling to identify the top five terms for each story. We then calculated cosine similarity using Word2Vec embeddings between these top terms and the provided interest and moral.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 (ver. 0613, temperature 0.4) was used as an evaluator in both experiments. Initially, it assessed the integration of personalized elements. Later, it was used to evaluate the stories for satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness, with a sample of the evaluation process and prompts provided in Appendix Figure.

answer_4.quote: In both experiments, the same 26 human evaluators—all students from diverse disciplines—were tasked with evaluating the narratives (for demographic details, see Appendix Figure).
answer_4.guideline: They provided feedback on all three story types, rating them on satisfaction, quality, engagement, and personalness. The detailed questionnaire is provided in Appendix A.2.
